## Project

This project studies how an industrial-policy intervention affects firms and workers beyond its direct recipients. The analysis focuses on input, labour, and local-demand linkages to distinguish private programme effects from the wider equilibrium consequences relevant to policy design.

<p class="draft-note">Results are not yet available. For updates on this project, <a href="mailto:t.dobermann@lse.ac.uk">get in touch</a>.</p>
